\begin{exercise} \end{exercise} 1. ch5:5-3↗ prob:connections-difference-tensor

Define a connection on $\mathbb {R}^3$ by setting (in standard coordinates) \[ \Gamma _{12}^3 = \Gamma _{23}^1 = \Gamma _{31}^2 = 1, \qquad \Gamma _{21}^3 = \Gamma _{32}^1 = \Gamma _{13}^2 = -1, \] with all other connection coefficients equal to zero. Show that this connection is compatible with the Euclidean metric and has the same geodesics as the Euclidean connection, but is not symmetric. (See Problem 4-9.) \end{exercise}
